A once-in-a-company opportunity to lead engineering early as the company scales! 🚀

• Want to set the technical direction and still ship code yourself?

• How would you help four engineers release several times a week without every decision landing on your desk?

• Where would you draw the line between what an AI agent should suggest and what it can do on a property owner’s behalf?

Sounds like you? Then you might be our next CTO!

A property owner with a portfolio of buildings has a practical question: which repairs belong in next year’s budget, and which can wait? At Proprty.ai, our models estimate the condition and remaining life of building components, software turns those estimates into maintenance plans, and our AI agent, Tily, helps owners analyze their portfolios and take action!

Our product went live in 2024 and is used by customers in Denmark, Norway and Germany. We reached profitability by the end of 2025 and raised DKK 21 million in April 2026, and we are not planning to stop there!

There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance and how engineering is run at Proprty.ai.

Our stack: React, TypeScript, Next.js, SQL, and PostgreSQL, git, mcp

Backend - Python, Databricks, Azure

What you get to shape

The team and the code. You’ll lead four engineers and keep building core features. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself that afternoon. As the team grows, you’ll help hire the people you’ll work alongside.

How we build and ship. You’ll guide the platform’s architecture and how we test and release. Our goal is to ship several times a week while keeping the product reliable and secure. When an urgent customer request competes with longer-term platform work, you’ll help the team with day-to-day prioritization on what comes first and why.

Shape what Tily can do next. Our data scientists work with models trained on building data covering millions of square meters. You’ll work with them to bring those models into production and draw on feedback from property owners, Sales and Customer

Success to decide which problems Tily should tackle next.

Change how we use AI ourselves. We use Cursor and Perplexity today. You’ll have room to try new workflows, keep the ones that help us build better software, and drop the ones that just give us more code to review.

We talk a lot (in a good way). When a problem gets tricky, we pull up a chair and pair on it. We like having a laugh while we figure things out.

What you’ll bring?

You’ve led an engineering team at a startup or scale-up while the product, the team and the rules were still taking shape. You know when to open a pull request yourself, when to let another engineer make the call, and which shortcut will come back to bite you two releases from now.

You bring curiosity about our industry, our customers' problems, and the business acumen to understand how our product delivers business value, so that you can help facilitate features that drive outcomes and make our users' lives easier.

We’re AI-first (the name’s a bit of a giveaway). If you’ve built an agent or shipped an AI feature, we’d love to hear what happened after the demo. What did customers trust it to do, and where did they want the controls back? You’ll get to make those calls with Tily and figure out where AI helps our own engineers ship better software.

The core of what we consider for a candidate

• You’ve led an engineering team, coached developers, and hired people to join it.

• You’re keen to build AI agents that customers can put to work and to explore where AI makes your own team more effective.

• You still build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, and SQL. You can take a feature from technical design through thoughtful user experience to release, and measure what happens when customers get their hands on it.

• Fluent in English

Experience we’d love to hear about

• Taking an engineering team from a startup to a scale-up phase, understanding how and when to mature processes as the team scales, and how that looks different in this new AI era.

• Shipping an AI agent or feature into production. We’re especially curious about what you changed after people started using it.

• How you’ve spoken with customers and industry experts to help ensure we’re on the forefront of solving the right problems in our platform

• Your perspective on the role of a CTO as a thought leader.

• Working with PostgreSQL or Next.js, or building products for real estate or proptech.

Where we work

We spend 4 days a week together in our office near Rådhuspladsen. You’ll need to be based in the Copenhagen area, as we can’t offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.

New to proptech? That’s fine. If you’ve led engineers and still enjoy being one, we’d love to hear from you.

Questions? Reach out to Casper høgh at Csh@ing.dk, who helps us land the right human for the job

Our hiring process

• Intro call with Casper Høgh – We’ll talk about your background, what you want from your next CTO role, and any questions you have about proprty.ai.

• In-person interview – Meet us at our Copenhagen office for a small demo and talk through the team, the decisions you’d own, and how you like to lead while staying hands-on.

• Case interview – Work through an engineering scenario with us. We want to understand what you’d prioritize, which trade-offs you see, and why.

• Board interview - Meet with one of our board members. Get their perspective on our journey and talk them through how you would help us in our next phase of growth.

• Offer – If we both see a fit, we’ll talk through the offer and next steps together.

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code?

Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

Manager, Skilled Workers – Packaging & Filling Line Maintenance

**Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Are you an experienced leader with a strong understanding of manufacturing operations and a passion for developing skilled technical employees?

Do you thrive in an operational environment where people leadership, equipment reliability and continuous improvement are equally important?

Are you ready to take responsibility for a skilled maintenance team and help strengthen operational performance within HRT Packaging?

If so, we would like to hear from you.

**The Position

**As Manager, Skilled Workers within HRT Packaging, you will lead a team of skilled maintenance employees responsible for supporting the reliability and performance of packaging and filling equipment at our Måløv site.

This is an operational leadership position requiring someone who understands the realities of a production environment and has already demonstrated the ability to lead technical employees.

You will have the opportunity to shape how the team operates, develop the capabilities of experienced technical employees and contribute directly to the department's operational performance.

Working closely with Production and other technical functions, you will balance immediate operational requirements with longer term maintenance improvements, ensuring your team has the direction, structure and support needed to succeed.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing skilled maintenance employees, establishing clear expectations, accountability and continuous development.

• Managing daily maintenance priorities, resources and team performance to support reliable production.

• Ensuring effective preventive and corrective maintenance to improve equipment reliability and minimise downtime.

• Using maintenance data, KPIs and performance trends to identify opportunities and make informed operational decisions.

• Supporting structured problem-solving and addressing recurring equipment issues.

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

• Building effective working relationships with Production, Quality, Engineering and other relevant stakeholders.

• Ensuring maintenance activities comply with GMP, safety and quality requirements.Creating a positive, collaborative and performance focused team culture.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced operational leader who understands both the technical and people-related challenges of managing skilled employees within a manufacturing environment.

**To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

**

• Proven experience leading skilled technical employees within a manufacturing environment, including responsibility for team performance, employee development and day-to-day operational delivery.

• Demonstrable experience managing or formally supervising employees within maintenance, engineering, production or a comparable technical function.

• Practical experience coaching employees, addressing performance challenges and handling difficult leadership situations.

• A sound understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment reliability and manufacturing operations.

• Experience using operational data or performance indicators to support decisions and drive improvements.

• Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

• Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP regulated operations, packaging equipment or filling processes would be advantageous.

• We also welcome applications from experienced supervisors and team leaders who have already demonstrated meaningful people leadership and are ready to take on broader management responsibility.

• About YouYou are a confident, visible and approachable leader who enjoys working closely with skilled technical employees.

• You understand that effective leadership requires more than technical knowledge. You can set clear expectations, address performance challenges, coach employees and create an environment where people take ownership of their work.

• You are comfortable making decisions in a busy production environment, using data and operational insights to establish priorities.

• You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and can constructively challenge stakeholders when necessary.

• Above all, you bring the maturity, accountability and practical leadership experience needed to develop a team while maintaining operational performance.

**About The Department

**You will join HRT Packaging at our Måløv site, part of Novo's manufacturing organisation.

The department is responsible for packaging hormone replacement therapy products, contributing to the delivery of medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients.

Our maintenance teams play an essential role in ensuring that production equipment operates safely, efficiently and reliably.

With increasing production demands, we are continuing to strengthen our maintenance capabilities, equipment performance and ways of working.

As Manager, Skilled Workers, you will have the opportunity to influence how the team develops and contributes to the department's future success.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, your skills, dedication and ambition help us change lives for the better.

In return, we offer an opportunity to work alongside talented colleagues, take on meaningful responsibilities and continue developing professionally and personally.

Working at NovoAt Novo,

we don't wait for change. We drive it.

We're a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future.

We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop; we seize them.

From research and development to manufacturing, marketing and sales, we're all working to move the needle on patient care.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is DKK 651,000 to 956,900 annually.

The final salary will depend on the candidate's qualifications, experience and applicable employment conditions.

**Incentives And Benefits

**At Novo, we offer a competitive remuneration package and a range of benefits designed to support our employees' professional and personal wellbeing.

Applicable benefits and incentive arrangements will be discussed as part of the recruitment process.

**What We Offer

**There is nothing ordinary about working at Novo.

Our purpose is to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases, building upon our heritage in diabetes.

We do so by pioneering scientific breakthroughs, expanding access to our medicines and working to prevent and ultimately cure disease.

We offer an inclusive and collaborative working environment where employees can develop their capabilities, contribute their ideas and make a meaningful difference.

**Inclusive Recruitment

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to be the best company for the world, and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures.

We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and the communities in which we operate.

Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Senior Manager Of Customer Experience & Product At AtNorth

**Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

• Set standards for customer onboarding, communication, enablement, knowledge and self-service experiences.

• Own Customer Operations governance of the service catalogue, customer-facing service definitions and product/service lifecycle input.

• Define and prioritize customer-facing requirements for the portal, CRM, Jira and other digital and self-service capabilities.

• Ensure customer needs, commercial priorities and operational realities are reflected in product, service and platform roadmaps.

• Lead and develop the Product Manager and Customer Experience Manager, setting direction, priorities, performance expectations and development goals

• Represent customer experience and product priorities in management, governance and roadmap forums.

• Drive cross-functional priorities by aligning stakeholders across Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance.

• Monitor progress against Customer Experience & Product OKRs, strategic priorities and improvement roadmaps, identifying risks and driving timely decisions.

You will also have the authority to set functional priorities, allocate work across Product Management and Customer Experience, and prioritize customer-facing product, service, process and platform improvements within agreed strategy, budget and governance boundaries. In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

**Your profile:

**We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing customer-facing digital platforms, requirements or self-service capabilities.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

**Description

**Factbird is a manufacturing intelligence suite that turns real-time production data into actionable insights. Our plug-and-play hardware and AI-powered SaaS solution help manufacturers cut downtime, improve efficiency and reduce waste. We are around 100 people across Europe and the US, growing more than 50% year over year. We have just partnered with the private equity firm Verdane to strengthen our product roadmap and expand our reach even further.

We have built a solid Revenue Operations foundation, with HubSpot as our CRM, BigQuery as our data warehouse, and Power BI and Claude for reporting that the leadership team and the board rely on. Now we want to take the next step. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager who doesn't just keep the engine running, but tells us where to steer it.

This is a role for someone who looks at our numbers and asks "so what?" Which segments should we double down on? Where is the funnel leaking? Which investments will pay back? What can we do even better? You will help answer those questions and make sure the answers lead to action.

**The role

**You will own Revenue Operations across the full customer journey, from the first marketing touch to sales, onboarding, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to unify the processes, technology, and data behind our revenue teams so that growth becomes more predictable, transparent, and scalable.

You will be based at our office at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, report to the CFO, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and the senior leadership team. You will lead our Business Intelligence Analyst, who owns the data warehouse, the data pipelines, and the Power BI dashboards.

You will thrive here if you combine a commercial mindset with analytical rigor, and you enjoy turning a messy question into a clear recommendation that a leadership team can act on.

**What You'll Do

**Planning and GTM

• Turn performance, customer, and market data into clear recommendations: where to invest, which segments and industries to prioritize, and what isn't working.

• Support commercial planning with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including targets, quotas, and capacity planning.

• Support sales leadership on territory design, lead routing, and pipeline coverage.

Data and Intelligence

• Develop the commercial KPIs that matter across the funnel, such as pipeline, conversion, win rates, CAC, churn, and net revenue retention, and understand the data behind it.

• Own the monthly commercial performance reporting for the leadership team and present the story and learnings behind the numbers.

• Lead deep-dive analyses, such as ICP and industry performance, win/loss and churn drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

• Lead and develop our Business Intelligence Analyst: set priorities, goals, and development plans.

Best in Class Processes

• Map our processes from lead to renewal, find the bottlenecks, and fix them together with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

• Design workflows and hand-offs that cut admin time and improve data quality for Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

Technology and AI

• Foster the adoption of AI across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success: connect AI assistants to our CRM and data, and build AI-powered workflows for enrichment, lead scoring and reporting. AI-powered tools in our current stack include Gong, Amplemarket, Claude and Dreamdata.

• Measure the impact of AI and automation on productivity and pipeline.

Revenue Funnel Pursuit

• Give the revenue teams the insights, tools and cadences they need at every stage of the funnel, from demand generation to renewal and expansion.

• Support Marketing on attribution, intent data and campaign reporting.

• Support Customer Success with health, churn-risk and expansion insights.

Project Management

• Plan and deliver cross-functional revenue projects from scope to measurable impact.

• Lead the change management that comes with new processes and tools, so they stick.

**What We're Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded problem solver who uses data to drive decisions and create value. You understand what drives growth in a B2B business, you are comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you are hands-on enough to get into HubSpot yourself.

The ideal background

• 5 to 7 years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, commercial analytics, strategy or management consulting, or a similar role.

• Experience from a B2B SaaS or tech scale-up, where you have seen what drives growth up close.

• A proven track record of turning data into insights and recommendations that leaders acted on.

• Strong analytical skills: you may have been a Business Intelligence Analyst in the past. You are definitely at home with funnel metrics, unit economics and forecasting, and you can build a model in Excel or a BI tool.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.

Department: Marketing

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers see what’s really happening on their production lines. Our lightweight hardware products are installed directly on the production lines and collect data from the machines without the need of heavy consultant implementations. Our hardware turn data into real-time insight on production output, downtime, and efficiency, so the people on the factory floor and in management can make better decisions. Today we have 300+ customers across Europe and US, and with a recent partnership with Verdane, we are looking to scale our efforts even further.

Coming this far has only been possible by relentlessly understanding our customer’s pains and needs and turning that into solutions that generate real-world value in the manufacturers’ day-to-day. As our customer base grows, some of the most valuable conversations we can have are with the manufacturers already using Factbird every day: helping them get more out of the platform, showing them the value they’ve achieved, and giving them good reasons to tell others about it. That’s why we’re hiring our first dedicated Customer Marketing Manager.

You’ll join our marketing team and work side by side with our Product Marketing Director, the Marketing team and Customer Success to support building programs that turn customers into long-term partners and advocates.

**The role

**As Customer Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing for everyone who is already a Factbird customer; from their first weeks on the platform to their renewal and beyond. You’ll design and run the lifecycle, expansion, and advocacy programs that help customers adopt more of Factbird, see the value they’re getting, and grow with us.

This is also a data-informed role. You’ll use product usage data from Mixpanel and customer data in HubSpot to understand how accounts actually use Factbird and turn those insights into communication that’s relevant and well-timed. You’ll also make sure what customers tell us reaches product marketing to support campaigns and positioning.

You’ll report to Frederik Krogtoft, Product Marketing Director, and be part of the Marketing team based in Copenhagen.

**What You'll Do

**Lifecycle, adoption & education

• Build and run onboarding journeys in HubSpot, email flows and welcome packs, that help new customers get up and running quickly.

• Plan feature-adoption campaigns based on Mixpanel usage data, targeted at the accounts that will benefit most.

• Promote professional services and training to under-engaged accounts.

• Build and maintain the Factbird Academy, our customer knowledge base.

Expansion & account-based marketing

• Run campaigns that communicate our roadmap and the value of new products to existing customers.

• Build upsell and cross-sell nurture flows.

• Produce content for ABM campaigns, from micro-vertical programs to 1:1 account campaigns and source the customer data these programs need.

Customer advocacy & reviews

• Build and run our customer referral program.

• Manage the pipeline of customer quotes and logo permissions.

• Source customers for case studies (production is handled by our Content team) and recruit customer speakers for events.

• Run internal and external campaigns to earn high ratings and rankings on review sites such as G2 and Capterra.

Customer insights, voice of the customer & retention

• Turn product usage (Mixpanel) and CRM (HubSpot) data into customer insights that feed our campaigns and positioning.

• Collect customer feedback, report on NPS, and route insights to Product Marketing

• Partner with Customer Success and own the CSAT and NPS survey cadence and make sure responses get the right follow-up.

• Partner with Customer Success on customer health reporting and set up campaign triggers for accounts that show churn risk.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for a hands-on customer marketer who is equally at home with data and with words. You build programs from scratch rather than waiting for a playbook; you work easily across teams, and you always make the customer the hero of the story.

The Ideal Background

• 3–5 years of experience in customer and/or product marketing, ideally in a B2B SaaS company.

• Hands-on experience building email journeys and segmentation in HubSpot.

• A track record in customer advocacy, such as references, case studies, referral programs, or review-site campaigns (G2, Capterra).

• Experience with account-based marketing.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**

Your impact begins here

As Sr. DOL Engagement Manager, you will set the strategic direction for how Novo engages Digital Opinion Leaders (DOLs) across our global portfolio today and in the future. You will work closely with global colleagues in Product & Portfolio Strategy as well as International Operations and US Operations to drive planning and successful execution of DOL Engagement priorities with strong business impact.

What you’ll bring

**Essential

**

• Master’s degree in science, Marketing, Business Administration, DOL Project Management or a related field.

• 5–8 years of experience with DOL engagement, strategic scientific communication, marketing strategy and execution.

• A proven track record of leading complex projects with functional impact, preferably with informal leadership

• Strong strategic planning skills, with the ability to turn business priorities into DOL engagement plans and see them through across campaigns and events.

• Excellent stakeholder management communication and presentation skills, including with senior leaders and external partners.

• The ability to make informed decisions in complex, fast-changing situations, and to stay focused when priorities shift.

What you’ll do

You will become part of a team shaping how we strategically work with DOL engagement in Novo.

• Set clear strategic priorities and KPIs for global DOL engagement, and drive planning and execution against them.

• Build scalable frameworks and lean processes that make DOL engagement easier to repeat across assets and markets.

• Lead projects, timelines and budgets, monitor spend against financial targets and adapt when priorities change.

• Coordinate agencies, vendors and internal teams to deliver high-quality engagements, and use performance data and feedback to keep improving.

• Build close partnerships with stakeholders across PPS, International Operations and US Operations to align objectives and expectations.

• Share DOL engagement activities and their business impact through internal channels such as newsletters, SharePoint and webinars.

• Meet compliance and quality requirements (QMS) that apply to the role.

You will join Congresses & DOL Engagement in Product & Portfolio Strategy (PPS) team based out of Soborg, Denmark.

Your closest partners will be leaders and colleagues across PPS, International Operations and US Operations, at global, regional and affiliate level, including Global Public Affairs and Corporate Legal. Externally, you will work with agencies, vendors and thought leaders.

As this is a global role, you should expect to work with different time zones and have around 15–20 days of travel per year. Decisions in this role are often complex and need alignment with senior stakeholders, so you are expected to bring clarity, speak up early and keep work moving.

We expect you to come up with new ideas, take initiative and drive your priorities, in a role where the work is varied, complex and often without precedence. You will be trusted to perform, supported to grow, and encouraged to make your voice heard. Once a decision is made, we move forward together.

You will build new skills by working across Novo’s global, regional and affiliate teams, and by learning from the experts you partner with.

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape how Novo engages Digital Opinion Leaders worldwide, apply for the Sr. DOL Engagement Manager role by 18th Nov, 2026.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

Department: **Sustainability Data Solutions & AI

**Location: **Bagsværd, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**As an intern in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI, you will turn sustainability data into insight Novo can act on. You will develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, and help make that data cleaner, more reliable and easier to reuse. Working on real business challenges alongside experienced data analysts and engineers, you will see your work support decisions across the organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are curious, analytical and motivated by using data and technology to solve sustainability challenges. You are a student, and you bring:

A basic understanding of sustainability, environmental data or ESG topics, for example energy, water or greenhouse gas emissions.

Experience with Power BI or another data visualisation or BI tool.

Experience with at least one coding language, such as Python.

An interest in AI, automation and advanced analytics, and in how they can be applied to sustainability challenges.

A structured way of working with a clear eye for detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting those around you.

The ability to explain data clearly to colleagues with less technical insight, with strong written and spoken English.

Familiarity with data engineering, data pipelines or cloud-based analytics platforms, such as Databricks.

Knowledge of statistical modelling, operational research or operations management.

Experience with larger datasets, including data cleaning, transformation, validation or analysis.

**What You’ll Do

**You will contribute to real projects, taking ownership of selected tasks while supporting the wider team’s initiatives. Your work will help strengthen how sustainability data is collected, integrated, analysed and used across Novo.

Develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, turning operational data into actionable business insight.

Support the integration and automation of sustainability data in the Sustainability Data Foundation, including data pipelines and automated recurring reporting and data-quality controls in Databricks.

Improve the quality, transparency and availability of sustainability data by creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets in line with the FAIR principles: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable.

Support the digitalisation of sustainability data and analytics by connecting sustainability information with relevant business and operational metrics.

Contribute to BI solutions for reporting, forecasting and decision-making, as well as ad hoc analyses across sustainability data and technology.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Sustainability Data Solutions & AI team, part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights department. The team of data analysts and data engineers drives data analytics on the sustainability agenda for Novo. The department has eight colleagues at headquarters, two in Poland and two in Bangalore, India, so you will work with colleagues across locations.

You will also work closely with stakeholders across Novo who are helping to implement the sustainability strategy across the value chain. Your manager will be [insert hiring manager name]. You will move work forward by bringing technical depth and clear communication together, from deep dives into the data to conversations with colleagues who are less familiar with it.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work on real business challenges, with room to take ownership and make your voice heard. You will learn from experienced data and sustainability professionals, build practical skills in tools such as Databricks and Power BI, and see how data and AI are applied to sustainability across a global organisation. The pace is fast, and you will be supported to perform at your best.

If allowed by your educational institution, the internship is paid at a fixed monthly base rate of DKK 15,900, plus a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn sustainability data into insight and progress, apply for the Internship in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI by November 20, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
